bias.en: Uptrend · cleared the $388 cap and the 200-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 突破 $388 上限和 200 日均线

read.en: Tesla rose 5.2% on Oct 26 to $391.62, trading between $383.84 and $397.27 on 1.5 times average volume. It is above the rising 5-day ($379.7), 10-day ($372.6) and 30-day ($370.6) averages and the falling 100-day ($367.9) and 200-day ($386.1). MACD crossed back above its signal on Oct 26 and is above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($353.16), and RSI is 60.
read.zh: 特斯拉 10月26日上涨 5.2%，收于 $391.62，盘中区间 $383.84–397.27，成交量为均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于上行的 5 日（$379.7）、10 日（$372.6）和 30 日均线（$370.6）以及下行的 100 日（$367.9）和 200 日均线（$386.1）上方。MACD 于 10月26日重新上穿信号线，且位于零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$353.16），RSI 为 60。

read.en: The close cleared the $388 cap and the 200-day ($386.1), now support. Resistance is $397.3 (Oct 26 high), then $409.3 (Apr 17 high) and $416.4–420.3 (Mar 11 and Feb 25 highs). Support is $386.1–388.9 (200-day, $388 cap, Oct 22 high), then $377.6–379.7 (Oct 20 high, 5-day) and $367.9–372.6 (10, 30 and 100-day). A close above $397.3 would target $409; below $386, $378.

s.en: $388 cap since March, cleared; 200-day average $386.1; Oct 22 high $388.86
